notes.title: CASTLE ON THE COAST - a cute 3D platformer starring the giraffe just kicked off!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello undaunted T-Rex fans![/h3]

[h2]We are more than happy to announce that Castle on the Coast, a new charming 3D collectathon is READY TO PLAY! [/h2]
Be ready to explore the magical castle along with George, the official mascot of Valley Children’s Hospital!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341900/Castle_on_the_Coast/ 
https://youtu.be/djzH1AYRNpk

[h3]About the game[/h3]

[b]Castle on the Coast[/b] is a 3D platformer with classical collectathon mechanics and George the Giraffe as the protagonist. You will parkour through a magic castle, explore challenging large-scale open levels full of crystal caverns, stone-laden halls, and trippy alternate dimensions, and try to bring together a family of the two powerful, conflicted wizards. 

Thanks to cooperation mode, even the youngest gamers will be able to enjoy George’s adventures, playing together with their friends or their sitters. Besides all the arcade fun, Castle on the Coast offers a more severe and moral angle. It will touch upon dealing with loss, conflict, and loving your enemies.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38469052/d7563765027d6caddc3421cb367ecba804a287d5.png[/img]

[h2]AND THERE'S SOMETHING SPECIAL[/h2]

[h3]To celebrate the premiere of [b]Castle on the Coast[/b] even more and make it more festive, we've prepared a special BUNDLE: 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23840/Best_Platformers][b]BEST PLATFORMERS[/b][/url] bundle by Klabater! 

Now, you can not only chase away the aliens and bring peace to Earth and SUE!... but get the entire package of Klabater's platformer games, with a sweet discount of 25% for the bundle! [/h3]
Get 3 games instead of one:
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/834450/Roarr_The_Adventures_of_Rampage_Rex/]Roarr! The Adventures of Rampage Rex[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/582920/From_Shadows/]From Shadows[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341900/Castle_on_the_Coast/]Castle on the Coast[/url]
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341900/Castle_on_the_Coast/  
[h2]THE GAME IS ALREADY AVAILABLE! IT IS TIME TO EXPLORE MAGICAL CASTLE ON THE COAST[/h2]

notes.title: HELIBORNE: ENHANCED EDITION AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

[i]Heliborne[/i] is one of the most successful Klabater's releases. Initially released in 2017, it remains one of the publisher’s flagships. Today we would love to let you know that the game just debuted in its ultimate shape!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/b679693ecfa085b455b2ba8cff0639dc9f29d810.jpg[/img]

[i]Heliborne[/i], the Ultimate Helicopter Warfare Experience, is now taken to new heights as the game officially becomes [b][i]Heliborne: Enhanced Edition[/i][/b]! The game’s definitive edition brings not only tons of improvement and new content but also debuts at a new price (29,99 USD/EUR) for both the game and all DLCs included! 

--> Heliborne: Enhanced Edition [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433530/Heliborne/]Steam Card[/url]
--> WATCH HELIBORNE ENHANCED EDITION[url=https://youtu.be/28X5Dn9Zw-0] TRAILER[/url]

From now on there is only one ‘Enhanced’ edition of the game containing the base game with all the DLCs released until now (over a dozen!) in the price of the regular game! [b]Klabater decided that all the gamers who already paid for the original edition will now receive Enhanced Edition and ALL DLCs for free[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/67427e0114be9e46650b7dd2044510f40ded0839.jpg[/img]

[i]Heliborne: Enhanced Edition[/i] is the next big step for the franchise, meant as a final version of the [i]Heliborne[/i] game dedicated to those who love the game already but also for newcomers. It’s a brand new visual quality mixed with significant gameplay overhaul. The development team is now working on the console edition of Enhanced Edition, and more info will be revealed soon!

With [i]Heliborne: Enhanced Edition[/i], the Ultimate PC Helicopter Warfare Experience is now taken to new heights! 
[list]
[*] New Prototype Machines 
[*] Fully Upgraded Game Engine 
[*] New Day & Night Maps 
[*] Updated in-game Physics 
[*] Empowered Multiplayer Experience 
[*] Refreshed User Interface
[/list]
[b]As we promised to our community, all who have bought the game before will get the free update to Enhanced Edition! This is our way of saying thank you’ to all the community that helped us and supported us for years. So, even if you own the basic version of the game with no DLC installed, you will still get access to both the Enhanced Edition of the game and ALL DLCs released until now! Enjoy![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/8df5edc6ebc48de7fbfd170c2c503e9d1c54e615.jpg[/img]
[b]WHAT’S IN IT FOR THE PLAYERS?[/b]

With Heliborne: Enhanced Edition players get the basic game and over a dozen of cool DLC at a very, very reasonable price. A summary of a player’s ‘savings’ below:
[list]
[*] The previous Heliborne price was 19,99 USD/EUR, and DLCs were altogether worth   54,85 USD/EUR... So, until now, the whole package cost 75 USD/EUR.
[*] From August 20, the 75 USD/EUR value content will be priced at 29,99 USD/EUR... As simple as that! You get EVERYTHING at once, and [b]you SAVE 60%[/b]! 
[/list]
KLABATER TEAM

notes.title: Play the demo + Support Help Will Come Tomorrow crowdfunding campaign!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/86b7ab539c123be8cae35d4feab78aa8d9a32cc4.jpg[/img]

Friends!

We are happy to let you know that today we’ve launched a crowdfunding campaign for Help Will Come Tomorrow, a true-born survival game and another step in Klabater’s bold journey in search of meaningful, story-driven games. 

You will find our campaign here: klabater.com/HWCT_Kickstarter  

We encourage you to support the game! :)

We soooo are happy to finally unveil more details about Help Will Come Tomorrow. The game was shown during Gamescom 2019 previously, and we are now in a much more advanced stage of development. This is why we decided to add a demo, to let everyone know that Help Will Come Tomorrow is already in a good shape. We really think that we have found our own unique approach to survival game formula, with a more narrative-driven and psychological touch.

Help Will Come Tomorrow crowdfunding campaign is supported with many new game-related materials, among them screens and artwork, but above all else we encourage you to check: 
[list]
[*] Exclusive demo (first 3 days in the game, available on Steam Card of the game)
[*] New gameplay trailer
[/list]
https://youtu.be/UeaNRGK4GDc
[list]
[*] New Dev Diaries series:
[/list]
https://youtu.be/ERdxjWsiHh8
https://youtu.be/B0wHCqETQmE
https://youtu.be/iX3I7_YYvfg

Help us spread the word and share this news if you can :) Our fellow devs from Arclight Creations are now at the finish of development, but Help Will Come Tomorrow definitely requires extra help. Thanks to your support creators will be able to secure a top notch quality for the release!

Arclight Creations & Klabater

notes.title: Roarr! goes Jurassic with FREE DLC!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Great news, everyone![/b][/h1]

Starting from 30th of September, you will be able to feed your inner T-Rex with Carribean, Oriental or Warrior flavour for FREE! That's right, all of the DLCs will now be baseline and available to everyone.

But that's not all.. on the same day, the game will have its price permanently lowered to 2,99! Why not unleash your jurassic rage with this new, bargain price!?

This new deal will be available to PC users, but Mac owners - don't fret! If you purchased the game previously, you will not only keep it - on the 30th of September, the DLCs will also be free for you! You still have a week to purchase the game!

Become a T-Rex and fight aliens now!
